about: One row per JSON-RPC method the dispatcher answers. The set of `method` values must equal the dispatcher's match table exactly (test/qa_registry_test.dart fails otherwise), so a method cannot ship without a row. `class` decides what the harness is allowed to do: pure/read/sandbox run for real against an isolated data dir; mutating/network/desktop only run a refusal case, or carry a `skip` reason.

classes.pure: No OS state is read or written. Runs for real.
classes.read: Reads OS or DB state, writes nothing. Runs for real.
classes.sandbox: Would write, but only inside the isolated data dir the harness creates. Runs for real.
classes.mutating: Changes this machine (firewall, registry, hosts, services, files outside the sandbox). Only a refusal case runs, or it is skipped with a reason.
classes.network: Sends a request off the machine. Never runs here.
classes.desktop: Shows UI on the interactive desktop. Never runs here.
